module: Auxiliary controller for nitrous oxide (N2O) control (type "auxiliary", relevantDevice "mainEngine"). It arms/disarms the system via electrics.values (arming electrics value), purges the lines on arming and adds an "N2O" button to the simplified control panel and an entry to the radial menu. The injection itself is handled by the engine (engine.nitrousOxideInjection); this controller only handles the interface and the arming.
usage:
local n2o = controller.getControllerSafe('nitrousOxideInjection')
n2o.toggleActive()      -- arms/disarms
n2o.setOverride(true)   -- forces the injection (override electrics value)
notes: jbeam keys (default): name (controller name for the radial menu), engineName ("mainEngine"), electricsArmName ("nitrousOxideArm"), electricsOverrideName ("nitrousOxideOverride"), purgeTime (1, s).
The controller is only active (updateGFX) if the engine has an existing nitrousOxideInjection subsystem; otherwise M.updateGFX stays nop.
toggleActive: when arming (electrics value 0 -> 1) the line purge is started for purgeTime seconds; an Armed/Disarmed interface message is displayed.
serialize/deserialize/getState/setState handle the arming state (serialize) or the remaining purge time (getState).

init.desc: Reads the configuration, finds the engine, registers the radial menu and displays the state.

updateGFX.desc: Updates the simplified panel button when the tank, the arming or the activity change (nop if no N2O)

updateSimpleControlButtons.desc: (Re)creates the "N2O" button of the simplified panel with the color (inactive, armed, active) and the tank level.

setOverride.desc: Enables/disables the injection override electrics value.

toggleActive.desc: Arms or disarms the system (line purge on arming) and displays a message.
